```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", out.width = "100%")

# libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

# configuration
EXPORT_DIR <- "~/Kaylee_SP26"
FIGURE_DIR <- "figures"

SECTIONS <- tribble(
  ~section,                                 ~component,
  "Verb violation at the suffix",           "LAN_verb",
  "Verb violation at the suffix",           "N400_verb",
  "Verb violation at the suffix",           "P600_verb",
  "Verb stress at verb F0",                 "PrAN_verb",
  "Verb stress at verb F0",                 "PrAN_verb_oxy_cue",
  "Verb stress at verb F0",                 "PrAN_verb_parox_cue",
  "Verb stress at verb F0",                 "PrAN_verb_by_noun_cue",
  "Noun cue at noun F0",                    "PrAN_noun",
  "Noun violation at verb F0",              "LAN_noun",
  "Noun violation at verb F0",              "N400_noun",
  "Noun violation at verb F0",              "P600_noun",
  "Verb stress at verb F0 during training", "PrAN_training"
)

# data
clusters <- read_csv(file.path(EXPORT_DIR, "sp26_cluster_windows.csv"),
                     show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(component = factor(component, levels = SECTIONS$component)) |>
  arrange(component)

settings <- read_csv(file.path(EXPORT_DIR, "sp26_cluster_windows_settings.csv"),
                     show_col_types = FALSE)

# helper functions
minus <- function(x) str_replace_all(x, "-", "−")

p_value <- function(p) {
  if_else(p < .001, "*p* < .001",
          paste("*p* =", str_remove(sprintf("%.3f", p), "^0")))
}

capitalise <- function(x) paste0(toupper(str_sub(x, 1, 1)), str_sub(x, 2))

statement <- function(row) {
  if (str_starts(row$first, "after")) {
    sprintf("the difference (oxytone minus paroxytone) was %s %s than %s",
            row$direction, row$first, row$second)
  } else {
    sprintf("%s was %s than %s", row$first, row$direction, row$second)
  }
}

extent <- function(row) {
  sprintf("at %d %s (%s; largest at %s; mean difference %s µV; cluster %s, corrected %s)",
          row$n_channels, if (row$n_channels == 1) "electrode" else "electrodes",
          str_replace_all(row$channels, " ", ", "), row$peak_channel,
          minus(sprintf("%.2f", row$mean_difference)),
          p_value(row$p), p_value(row$p_corrected))
}

sentence <- function(row) {
  if (row$direction == "none") {
    sprintf("**%s.** No cluster was formed.", row$comparison)
  } else if (row$significant == 1) {
    sprintf("**%s.** %s %s. The cluster was %s after correction.",
            row$comparison, capitalise(statement(row)), extent(row),
            if (row$significant_corrected == 1) "significant" else "not significant")
  } else {
    sprintf("**%s.** No significant cluster. In the largest cluster, %s %s.",
            row$comparison, statement(row), extent(row))
  }
}

summary_list <- function(rows) {
  if (nrow(rows) == 0) {
    cat("\n- None.\n")
  }
  for (name in unique(rows$section)) {
    cat("\n**", name, "**\n\n", sep = "")
    found <- filter(rows, section == name)
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(found))) {
      cat("- ", found$heading[i], ". ",
          str_remove_all(sentence(found[i, ]), "\\*\\*"), "\n", sep = "")
    }
  }
}
```

# Method

- The tests on this page are the comparisons of the Results page, in the same order. They were tested with cluster-based permutation tests over all `r settings$electrodes` electrodes, and not in the region of interest (ROI) of each component.
- The tests follow the EEGLAB group analysis tutorial. The amplitude was averaged over the time window of the component at every electrode, and the two conditions were compared with permutation statistics and cluster correction in FieldTrip, with the default cluster settings of EEGLAB.
- Neighbouring electrodes with *p* < `r str_remove(sprintf("%.2f", settings$cluster_threshold), "^0")` formed a cluster. The sum of the *t* values of each cluster was compared with the largest cluster sums of `r settings$permutations` random permutations of the data, with a two-sided significance level of `r str_remove(sprintf("%.2f", settings$alpha), "^0")`.
- Each comparison was tested within each group at the pre test (pre) and at the post test (post), for `r settings$n_L1` first language (L1) speakers and `r settings$n_L2` second language (L2) learners of Spanish. These are the pairwise comparisons of the ANOVAs.
- Two time windows differ from the Results page. The P600 window is 500 to 700 ms, and the window of the PrAN to the noun cue is 136 to 200 ms.
- One comparison was added. The PrAN to verb stress was tested separately after an oxytone noun cue and after a paroxytone noun cue, with all six conditions, and the two were compared.
- `r settings$tests` tests were run. The *p* values were corrected for the false discovery rate (FDR) over the tests of each component, as the pairwise comparisons of the ANOVAs.
- Every comparison is reported, including the comparisons without a significant cluster.
- Each figure shows the difference between the two conditions in the time window for each group and phase. The electrodes of a cluster at *p* < .05 before correction are drawn as large dots.
- The electrodes of a cluster describe where the difference was found. They are not exact borders of the effect.

# Clusters significant after correction

```{r, results="asis"}
summary_list(filter(clusters, significant_corrected == 1))
```

# Clusters at *p* < .05 before correction only

```{r, results="asis"}
summary_list(filter(clusters, significant == 1, significant_corrected == 0))
```

```{r, results="asis"}
for (name in unique(SECTIONS$section)) {
  cat("\n\n# ", name, "\n\n", sep = "")

  for (part in SECTIONS$component[SECTIONS$section == name]) {
    rows <- filter(clusters, component == part)
    cat("\n**", rows$heading[1], "**\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("![](", file.path(FIGURE_DIR, rows$figure[1]), ")\n\n", sep = "")
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
      cat("- ", sentence(rows[i, ]), "\n", sep = "")
    }
    cat("\n")
  }
}
```
